title: Integers: The Other Side of Zero
summary: Negative numbers on the number line: comparing, adding and subtracting integers, with temperatures, lifts and bank balances.

ib.note: Integers are part of the MYP 1 Number strand

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Ch 10: The Other Side of Zero
Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 2: Operations with Integers

objectives: I can place and compare integers on a number line.
I can add and subtract integers, including subtracting a negative.
I can use integers to solve real-life problems.
misconceptions: −7 is bigger than −2 because 7 is bigger than 2.
Subtracting always makes a number smaller.
Two negatives always make a positive, even when adding.
